primary_goal: 复核 H36 独立前端 A/B 的 Windows .venv launcher RSS 采集范围，保留旧产物并用进程树采集实际解释器 RSS；不改源码、不重跑 H54。
hypothesis: Windows .venv\Scripts\python.exe launcher 会生成实际 uv Python 子进程；原 H36 RSS 仅采集 launcher，必须标记无效并重新执行 20 对 AB/BA；wall 和输出哈希仍可复用。

launcher_probe.result: launcher PID 27380 RSS 6098944; child PID 43364 actual uv Python RSS 12886016; sys._base_executable points to C:\Users\A\AppData\Roaming\uv\python\cpython-3.12-windows-x86_64-none\python.exe

data_roles.development: H36 prior 20 process pairs and launcher PID probe
data_roles.comparison: new 20 independent cold/warm process pairs, alternating AB/BA, three request scales
data_roles.final_acceptance: wall/output equivalence evidence only; corrected RSS engineering metric; no Native or production cache acceptance

entrypoint.warm: build_reference_scenario -> explicit TopologyAwareBatchCostProvider warmup -> measured run_scenario(batch_lowerer=provider) -> report_dict

correction.reason: run_one polled only psutil.Process(proc.pid), which is the .venv launcher; launcher PID RSS was about 6 MB while actual uv Python child was about 12.9 MB in probe.
correction.corrected_scope: sum RSS of launcher and recursive interpreter descendants per poll; peak process-tree RSS; observed child PIDs preserved in each pair record.

commands.role: verified launcher and actual interpreter process tree
20 independent AB/BA process pairs with corrected process-tree RSS

observations.output_equivalence: 20/20 pairs have equal report JSON hashes, makespan_ns, batch_count and request_count; all 40 child commands return 0.
observations.wall: warm median wall reductions remain ~57.98%, 75.56%, 74.85% for 1x64x4, 8x128x16, 16x128x16.
observations.corrected_rss: warm median RSS deltas are +1.98%, +1.43%, +5.25% respectively; only 2/20 pairs warm RSS lower. Therefore no RSS improvement and likely warm reuse retains more memory.

decision.finding: 原 RSS 结论作废；校正进程树后暖 provider 仍有等价 wall-time 工程收益，但三规模 RSS 均不降。
decision.acceptance: 接纳 wall/output 等价的 context-local explicit provider evidence；不接纳内存改善、生产共享缓存候选或 Native 精度。

uncovered: 没有安全共享 provider 生命周期、场景身份、eviction 或并发契约；暖路径不是新增生产机制。
RSS 仅进程树工作集峰值，未测 tracemalloc、OS page cache 或系统级工作集。
没有 Native/真实设备 TTFT/TPOT/E2E、预测精度或生产吞吐证据。
旧 RSS artifact 未覆盖并保留，不得复用其内存结论。
